title: GermanGamer's Modded Series
description: The Modpack used and seen in JustAGermanGamer's Modded Series
body:
# Main

This modpack was made for and by JustAGermanGamer to be used in the Modded Series on the JustAGermanGamer YouTube Channel [(Click here to view the Channel)](https://www.youtube.com/@justagermangamer101)

This Modpack is mainly made for Semi-Vanilla to lightly Modded, This concept might change in the future depending on how GermanGamer wants to shape and fledge his series out himself. The Modpack was made and posted here on Modrinth for his Audience and other Players outside of his Audience to enjoy the modpack he has made for the Minecraft Community. This Modpack loads in Fabric 1.21

# Specs

To Grasp how well this works for Users PC Specs and how well it runs on a Computer

GPU (Graphics Processing Unit): NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060
CPU (Central Processing Unit): Intel® Core™ i7 10700F @ 2.90GHz
RAM/Memory: 16GB DDR4 Memory - Single RAM Stick

With these Specs the Game can Run with Resource Packs added to the Modpack and Shaders without Lag
